mapper.select: SELECT DATE(update_time) AS date, IFNULL(SUM(total_money), 0) AS amount FROM bill WHERE is_del = 0 AND pay_status = 1 AND update_time >= #{start} GROUP BY DATE(update_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT d.doctor_name AS name, COUNT(m.record_id) AS count FROM medical_record m LEFT JOIN doctor d ON m.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE m.is_del = 0 AND m.doctor_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY m.doctor_id, d.doctor_name ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
